Interface LeaderboardRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
MySqlLeaderboardRepository
public interface LeaderboardRepository
Data-access abstraction for persisting and querying game results.

Implementations of this interface are responsible for storing each player's final score at the end of a game and for retrieving a ranked list of results filtered by player count. Callers are fully decoupled from the underlying storage technology through this interface.
